name: F00_3
notes: Linden, the Steadfast Queen. Printed: 'Whenever a white creature YOU control attacks, you gain 1 life.' 'You' is Linden's CONTROLLER, not its owner: seat 1 gains control of Linden. On seat 0's turn seat 0's white Knight attacks (2 damage: seat 1 at 18) and Linden, now seat 1's, triggers for nothing of seat 0's. On seat 1's turn seat 1's white Knight attacks (seat 0 at 18) and Linden triggers for it: seat 1 gains 1 (19).
